body:
I took about 25-50 mg meth and 1.5 grams of mushrooms and was completely unprepared for the results.  After a couple hours I started to feel very strange.  It was like my brain completely short circuited.  It was the most intense and horrifying trip in my life - for several hours I could _not_ think of anything good no matter what.  I thought I was never going to be able to think again.  I have taken mushrooms before many times and it was never like that - must be some combination with the meth.  I would recommend that no one ever mix mushrooms and methamphetamine, I thought I was going to die.  It was the most intense experience of my life - After 6-8 hours I was fine again.
